name: mlp-in-jax-from-scratch
title: Build an MLP in JAX from Scratch

parts.title: PRNG & Random Sampling
parts.description: Set up JAX's functional PRNG: wrap seeds, split keys, and sample random tensors.

parts.title: Synthetic Data & Labels
parts.description: Generate input features, assign deterministic class labels, and one-hot encode targets.

parts.title: Parameter Initialization
parts.description: Initialize a single linear layer and extend to a full MLP parameter list.

parts.title: Forward Pass Building Blocks
parts.description: Implement the linear layer, ReLU, softmax, and the full MLP forward pass.

parts.title: Loss & Metrics
parts.description: Compute log-softmax, mean cross-entropy loss, and classification accuracy.

parts.title: Autodiff & SGD Update
parts.description: Wrap the loss for autodiff, take gradients with jax.grad, and apply SGD updates.

parts.title: Training Loop & Inference
parts.description: Combine the pieces into a training step, an epoch loop, and a prediction function.

steps.name: make_prng_key
steps.doc: Create a PRNG key from an integer seed.

steps.name: split_prng_key
steps.doc: Split a PRNG key into `num` independent keys.

steps.name: sample_normal_matrix
steps.doc: Sample a standard normal array of the given shape.

steps.name: sample_input_features
steps.doc: Draw a standard-normal feature matrix of shape (n_samples, n_features).

steps.name: assign_class_labels
steps.doc: Label each row by argmax over sums of n_classes contiguous feature-column groups.

steps.name: one_hot_encode_labels
steps.doc: Return float one-hot rows of the integer labels with n_classes columns.

steps.name: init_linear_layer
steps.doc: Initialize one linear layer: W = scale * normal((in_dim, out_dim)), b = zeros(out_dim).

steps.name: init_mlp_params
steps.doc: Initialize a list of (W, b) layers by splitting keys across consecutive layer sizes.

steps.name: linear_forward
steps.doc: Apply an affine layer (W, b) to x: x @ W + b.

steps.name: relu_activation
steps.doc: Elementwise ReLU: max(x, 0).

steps.name: softmax_probabilities
steps.doc: Numerically stable softmax over the last axis.

steps.name: mlp_forward
steps.doc: Run the MLP: linear+ReLU on every layer except the last, which is linear only.

steps.name: log_softmax_logits
steps.doc: Compute the numerically stable log-softmax of logits over the last axis.

steps.name: cross_entropy_loss
steps.doc: Compute the mean cross-entropy loss between logits and one-hot targets.

steps.name: classification_accuracy
steps.doc: Compute the fraction of rows whose argmax prediction matches the integer labels.

steps.name: loss_fn_of_params
steps.doc: Cross-entropy loss as a pure function of params, for jax.grad to differentiate.

steps.name: compute_param_grads
steps.doc: Gradient of the loss with respect to params (same pytree structure).

steps.name: sgd_update_params
steps.doc: Apply one SGD step: subtract lr * grad from each parameter leaf.

steps.name: training_step
steps.doc: Perform one SGD step: compute the loss and grads, update params, return (new_params, loss).

steps.name: train_mlp
steps.doc: Run n_steps of full-batch SGD, returning the final params and the list of per-step losses.

steps.name: predict_classes
steps.doc: Return the predicted integer class for each row as the argmax of the MLP logits.
